in_marathi.name: Kamlakar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lotus in action
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kamlakar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kamala refers to lotus, and Kar means action. This name signifies the person who is in constant action, just like the lotus that blooms amidst water.

in_bengali.name: Kamlakar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lotus in action
in_bengali.long_meaning: Kamlakar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Kamala refers to lotus, and Kar means action. This name signifies the person who is in constant action, just like the lotus that blooms amidst water.
